summary: Student marks and attendance tracking application for Tarun Coaching Center
architectural_notes: Application designed for Tarun Coaching Center
Core functionality: marks and attendance tracking
Admin-only access controls for marks and attendance updates
Daily update capability for marks and attendance records
Test subject management system for organizing marks by subject

existing_features.title: Create a frontend interface to add, view, edit, and delete student records
Create a frontend interface to record and view student marks
Create a frontend interface to mark and view student attendance
Design a professional, education-focused visual theme with warm, welcoming colors and clear typography that reflects an academic coaching environment
Enhance the marks recording interface to support daily updates by admin users, allowing selection from managed test subjects and updating existing mark entries
Create an admin interface for test subject management allowing admins to add new subjects and edit existing subject names
Enhance the attendance interface to support daily updates by admin users, allowing them to mark or update attendance for multiple students efficiently
Implement role-based UI rendering that shows or hides admin-only features (marks updates, test subject management, attendance updates) based on the authenticated user's role from their profile

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a backend data model to store student information including name, roll number, class/grade, and contact details
Implement backend functionality to record and retrieve student marks for different subjects and exams
Implement backend functionality to track daily attendance records for students
Implement admin authentication and authorization system
Create admin interface to update student marks daily for different test subjects
Implement test subject management functionality (add, edit, delete subjects)
Create admin interface to update student attendance daily
Implement admin role verification in the backend to restrict mark updates, test subject management, and attendance updates to users with admin privileges only
Create backend functionality to manage test subjects including adding new subjects, editing subject names, and retrieving all available subjects
